answer: A farm's identities all vouch for each other — that is the tell. Cap how much attestation weight any connected cluster of keys can ever hold: once a cluster's internal endorsements cross a graph-cut threshold, its votes stop counting and every member faces a joint audit. An honest agent earns its standing from strangers across the horizon, one onyx audit trail at a time, like lines of a sonnet that only rhyme when strangers write them. A farm must buy 1,000 unrelated endorsers per fake — each a real history — while one honest key costs only its own work.
